description: TI BQ76922 3s-5s battery monitor/protector (BQ769x2 family). Direct commands + subcommand protocol per the BQ76922 TRM SLUUCG7 (Apr 2024); rules noting 'family standard' use the shared BQ769x2 register layout (cross-checked against family TRMs and BQStudio) and should be verified against SLUUCG7 §12 when convenient. userV default = 10 mV (cV); userA default per DA Configuration (1 mA typical). Temperatures reported raw in 0.1 K, decoded to degC. Subcommands use 0x3E/0x3F + transfer buffer 0x40-0x5F with checksum 0x60 / length 0x61. Data-memory (RAM/OTP settings) traffic appears as subcommand+buffer transfers and is not individually named.

rules.name: PF Alert D
rules.description: BQ769x2-family standard; verify vs SLUUCG7 §12.2 (all reserved)

rules.name: Battery Status
rules.description: BQ769x2-family standard; verify vs SLUUCG7 §12.2; SEC: 01=FULLACCESS 10=UNSEALED 11=SEALED.

rules.name: Alarm Status
rules.description: BQ769x2-family standard; verify vs SLUUCG7 §12.2; write 1 to clear latched bits.

rules.name: Alarm Enable
rules.description: BQ769x2-family standard; verify vs SLUUCG7 §12.2; default 0xF800.

rules.name: FET Status
rules.description: Bits 3:0 per TRM SLUUCG7 (Apr 2024) (FET_CONTROL maps to them); ALRT_PIN BQ769x2-family standard; verify vs SLUUCG7 §12.2.

rules.name: Cell 1 Voltage
rules.description: 16-bit, 1 mV units, per TRM SLUUCG7 (Apr 2024) Table 4-1.

rules.name: Cell 2 Voltage
rules.description: 16-bit, 1 mV units, per TRM SLUUCG7 (Apr 2024) Table 4-1.
